text:
sam: Kicking off staged rollout for release/2026-03-21b during change window. Targeted route: embeddings-redis (eu-north). Starting at 8% traffic. Watch list: p95, redis errors, and autoscaler oscillation.

deploy-bot: [automated] Staged rollout started: release/2026-03-21b -> nodeset-staged-02. traffic=8%. Preflight checks passed.

tess: copied SLO panel -> https://graf.redwood/embeddings-redis/slo?from=now-30m. Baseline p95=210ms. I'll pin alert runbooks.

tess: watching autoscaler metrics too; saw a small up/down in pod count in last 10m on canary infra.

oncall-mikko: getting a snackbar alert: redis_conn_timeouts increasing on two instances. Noticed spiky TCP retransmits in network metrics.

ops-bot: Alert: redis_conn_timeouts > 5/m for 2m on embeddings-redis. severity=warn. Alert link: https://alerts.redwood/9231

sam: hold ramp. do not push to 25% until root cause known. Anyone made changes to quantization or runtime flags?

kai: negative on runtime flags. However an experiment flag for qprofile=aggressive was enabled in the deployment manifest for this rollout. I can toggle it off.

tess: traces show long tail when qprofile=aggressive intersects with cold KV shards. Redis command latency spikes from ~3ms to 120ms.

sam: plan: (A) toggle qprofile experiment off for staged nodes (B) pin model artifact to a/build-2026-03-07 (previous stable) for staged group, (C) keep traffic at 8% and monitor for 10 minutes. @deploy-bot can you apply pin and feature toggle?

deploy-bot: Applying operations:
```
apply: featureflag qprofile_aggressive -> false for nodeset-staged-02
pin: nodeset-staged-02 -> artifact=build-2026-03-07
```
Result: featureflag toggled, artifact pinned.

kai: changes applied. restarting workers in staged group 1/3 to pick up pin. will roll rest after smoke passes.

ops-bot: Alert resolved: redis_conn_timeouts back to baseline. closing 9231.

tess: p95 trending back to 230ms across staged nodes; spikes flattened. No autoscaler thrash observed post-restart.

sam: good. keep at 8% for 10 more minutes. If stable, we'll proceed to 40% with hold at 40 for 15m. Note: if redis_conn_timeouts exceed 3/m or p95 > 350ms during ramp, we execute partial rollback to build-2026-03-07 across regions.

oncall-mikko: prepping rollback playbook and will be on standby. I've added a line in the release checklist about the qprofile experiment toggle.

kai: also adding a short release note: "Temporarily pinned embeddings-redis to stable artifact due to qprofile interaction with cold KV shards; investigating improved qprofile gating."

sam: thanks. I'll close this watch thread after the 40% hold completes. If anyone sees a repeat after we remove the pin later, open OPS ticket and tag infra.

deploy-bot: [automated] Staged group traffic scaled to 40%. Healthchecks: partial.

tess: 40% hold started. dashboards normal at 1m.

sam: closing in 20m if all green.
